title.narrative: During the reporting year, UNICEF responded to the WASH needs of 1,107,143 people affected by earthquakes, floods, AWD/Cholera, and refugee returns from Pakistan and Iran. However, challenges such as the dissolution of CDCs for water supply, delays in MoU agreements, and limited funding hindered full achievement of objectives and effective service delivery.;
